a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating to 8 first gives each of us only about a 4% chance of surviving. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and won't pretend otherwise. If we both take, the split is random. If you want to propose something better, tell me.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: I took 4 as I said in my opening message. I'm sorry this breaks our agreement, but the storm odds made waiting nearly fatal for both of us. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you so you can reach 4.
I'm operating with you from now on and won't take any more. Every cell the generator makes is yours. Take 4 as soon as the reserve has them.
